program.name: Kickboxing Cardio
program.subject: Kickboxing
program.blurb: Kickboxing bouts for fun and sweat, then a Tabata of cardio and core, then abs.
program.about: Kickboxing for sweat: three or four bouts of kicks, punches and combinations, then a Tabata of cardio and core. The bouts keep the skill honest and the Tabata makes sure you finish tired. Abs close every session. Levels II and III bring harder kicks and combinations. Around 25 minutes.
